# Third-Party Licenses

**Status: placeholder.** This file will be regenerated by `make licenses`
(which runs `cargo about generate` against `about.toml` and `about.hbs`)
once Phase 2 dependencies land. Regenerate after adding or updating crate
dependencies and commit the result.

The allowed license set is defined in `deny.toml`. Pull requests that
introduce crates with disallowed licenses will fail CI (`cargo deny check`).
